title: Chihaya main bailey
visualBrief: Whole declared surviving main bailey ground constituent at Chihaya Castle, retaining present numerical terrain shape and slope breaks within the explicit estimated precinct perimeter. Current uneven main-enclosure summit behind the shrine. Village text identifies the main precinct as the high ground behind the shrine and expressly says its present surface is not clearly flat. Original numerical field has the local summit near[132,118] at670.2289m; retain that source value rather than raising it to the published nominal673m. Estimated bounded summit-ground extent; surrounding belt terraces remain separately scoped. Later shrine/office/sign/stele/trees and all standing keep reconstructions excluded; surrounding belt terraces and the whole castle remain separately scoped.
